variants.name: Azure: Unauthorized Filesystem Read Activity
variants.description: Detects unauthorized read operations on the filesystem within an Azure environment, indicative of potential data exposure or exfiltration attempts.
variants.recommend: Implement strict access controls and regularly audit permissions to ensure only authorized entities can read sensitive data.
variants.remediate: Immediately revoke unauthorized access, review recent filesystem reads for suspicious activity, and validate the integrity of exposed data.

variants.name: Azure: Unusual Filesystem Write Operations
variants.description: Monitors for unexpected write operations to the filesystem that could indicate an attempt to modify or corrupt sensitive data.
variants.recommend: Enforce least privilege access and monitor for deviations from normal write patterns as a proactive measure against unauthorized modifications.
variants.remediate: Investigate the source of unusual writes, assess potential data integrity issues, and apply necessary patches or configuration changes.

variants.name: Azure: Filesystem Deletion Anomalies
variants.description: Triggers on unexpected deletion activities within filesystems that could signify attempts to remove evidence or sensitive information.
variants.recommend: Set up alerts for unauthorized deletions and maintain regular backups of critical data to mitigate potential loss or tampering.
variants.remediate: Conduct a thorough investigation into the deletion events, restore any lost data from backups if necessary, and review access controls.

variants.name: Azure: Unregistered Storage Operations
variants.description: Detects attempts to unregister storage operations which could be an indicator of trying to bypass security measures or hide malicious activities.
variants.recommend: Monitor for and restrict unauthorized attempts to unregister storage operations, ensuring all actions are logged and auditable.
variants.remediate: Review recent unregistration activities for anomalies, reinforce security policies around storage operation management, and validate system integrity.

variants.name: Azure: Unauthorized Storage Registration
variants.description: Identifies unauthorized attempts to register new storage operations, potentially indicating an effort to establish footholds or exfiltrate data.
variants.recommend: Implement stringent controls and monitoring on the registration of new storage operations to prevent unauthorized access or data leaks.
variants.remediate: Investigate the source of unauthorized registrations, revoke any illegitimate permissions, and ensure compliance with security policies.

variants.name: AWS: Unusual IAM User Creation
variants.description: Detects the creation of new IAM users which may indicate credential theft and unauthorized access attempts. Focuses on unexpected spikes in user creation activities.
variants.recommend: Implement stricter IAM policies and review user creation logs regularly to ensure compliance with organizational standards.
variants.remediate: Revoke access for suspicious users, investigate the source of the request, and enforce multi-factor authentication.

variants.name: AWS: Anomalous Access Configuration
variants.description: Monitors for unexpected changes in access configurations that could signal attempts to bypass security controls or escalate privileges.
variants.recommend: Regularly audit and review IAM policies and permissions, ensuring least privilege principles are applied.
variants.remediate: Revert unauthorized changes, investigate the origin of the configuration change, and update security policies as needed.

variants.name: AWS: Unexpected Connector Setup
variants.description: Tracks the creation of new connectors which may be used to establish unauthorized data exfiltration channels.
variants.recommend: Monitor and restrict connector setup activities, ensuring they align with business needs and security policies.
variants.remediate: Disable unauthorized connectors, review logs for suspicious activity, and enhance monitoring on data transfer endpoints.

variants.name: AWS: Unusual Server Configuration Changes
variants.description: Detects unexpected server configuration changes that could indicate attempts to compromise or alter system behavior.
variants.recommend: Implement change management processes and regularly review server configurations for unauthorized modifications.
variants.remediate: Revert changes, investigate the source of the modification, and strengthen configuration management practices.

variants.name: AWS: Unauthorized Profile Creation
variants.description: Identifies the creation of new profiles that may be used to impersonate legitimate users or services within the AWS environment.
variants.recommend: Enforce strict profile creation policies and regularly audit existing profiles for compliance with security standards.
variants.remediate: Delete unauthorized profiles, investigate the origin of the request, and enhance identity verification processes.
